question: Sir Tim Berners-Lee - a British computer scientist invented the revolutionary World Wide Web in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1990**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Tim Berners-Lee, a British computer scientist, generally credited as the inventor of the World Wide Web.
 
• The development of the World Wide Web was begun in 1989 by Tim Berners-Lee and his colleagues at CERN, an international scientific organization based in Geneva, Switzerland. 
 
• In 2004 he was awarded a knighthood by Queen Elizabeth II of the United Kingdom and the inaugural Millennium Technology Prize by the Finnish Technology Award Foundation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**NOTE: -**

 
• Tim Berners-Lee indeed began working on the idea for the World Wide Web in 1989 while at CERN, the European physics research center. However, the first successful communication between a web browser and a server via the Internet happened on December 25, 1990. Because the options provided do not include 1989, the closest accurate option would be:

**1990**

This represents the year when the World Wide Web became a functioning entity. However, if 1989 were an option, it would be the most accurate choice to represent when Berners-Lee first started developing the concept.
